# vintage_net_wizard v0.4.17 - Table of Contents

> WiFi Setup Wizard that uses VintageNet

## Pages

- [VintageNet WiFi Configuration Wizard](https://vintage-net-wizard.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [JSON API](https://vintage-net-wizard.hexdocs.pm/json-api.md)
- [Changelog](https://vintage-net-wizard.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [VintageNetWizard](https://vintage-net-wizard.hexdocs.pm/VintageNetWizard.md): Documentation for VintageNetWizard.

- [VintageNetWizard.APMode](https://vintage-net-wizard.hexdocs.pm/VintageNetWizard.APMode.md): This module contains utilities for configuration VintageNet in AP Mode

- [VintageNetWizard.Backend](https://vintage-net-wizard.hexdocs.pm/VintageNetWizard.Backend.md): Backends define the boundaries of getting access points, handling incoming
messages, and scanning the network

- [VintageNetWizard.Backend.Default](https://vintage-net-wizard.hexdocs.pm/VintageNetWizard.Backend.Default.md): The default backend implementation for target devices
- [VintageNetWizard.Backend.Mock](https://vintage-net-wizard.hexdocs.pm/VintageNetWizard.Backend.Mock.md): A default backend for host machines.
- [VintageNetWizard.BackendServer](https://vintage-net-wizard.hexdocs.pm/VintageNetWizard.BackendServer.md): Server for managing a VintageNet.Backend implementation

- [VintageNetWizard.Web.Endpoint](https://vintage-net-wizard.hexdocs.pm/VintageNetWizard.Web.Endpoint.md): Supervisor for the Web part of the VintageNet Wizard.

- [VintageNetWizard.WiFiConfiguration](https://vintage-net-wizard.hexdocs.pm/VintageNetWizard.WiFiConfiguration.md): Module for working with various WiFi configurations
